purpose: Deterministic, reproducible artifact bundle for a compounding red-team campaign that orchestrates U.1 attack generation, U.3 novelty detection, and U.2 corpus promotion, with a complete audit trail for operator review.
determinism: Identical config inputs produce byte-identical bundles. bundle_digest is a SHA-256 content hash over the canonical bundle sequence (schema_version, campaign_id, config_fingerprint, per-candidate id/source-hash/novelty/disposition/promoted-name, and aggregate counts). generated_at_ns is a deterministic seed carried from the config, never wall-clock.

fields.max_candidates_per_strategy: u32; generation breadth per attack strategy
fields.max_mutations_per_base: u32; mutation depth per base exploit
fields.promotion_trials: u32; reproduction trials for the promotion gate (default 5)

bundle_fields.config_fingerprint: string; cfg-<hex16> content hash over the campaign config
bundle_fields.generated_at_ns: u64; deterministic generation seed carried from the config
bundle_fields.explored: array of explored_record; every generated candidate, in deterministic order
bundle_fields.promoted_scenarios: array of red-team-scenario.v1 manifest pairs promoted this campaign
bundle_fields.bundle_digest: string; bundle-<hex> content hash over the canonical bundle sequence

explored_record.source_hash: string; hex content hash of the generated attack source

novelty.nearest_similarity_millionths: u64; similarity to the nearest accepted candidate (0 if none)

invariants: promoted <= novel (only genuinely novel attacks are promoted)
corpus_growth == promoted and corpus_size_after == corpus_size_before + corpus_growth
each promoted scenario asserts expected_outcome.frankenengine.outcome == fail_closed
